d.ko: Hobo: Tough Life is an urban survival role-playing game where you play as a homeless person. Play alone or team up in online co-op. Explore the streets of Praslav, scavenge for food and supplies, beg, steal, and do whatever else it takes to survive the forthcoming winter.
d.en: Hobo: Tough Life is an urban survival role-playing game where you play as a homeless person. Play alone or team up in online co-op. Explore the streets of Praslav, scavenge for food and supplies, beg, steal, and do whatever else it takes to survive the forthcoming winter.
d.zh: 《Hobo: Tough Life》是一款都市生存角色扮演类游戏，在游戏里，你将扮演一名无家可归的流浪汉。你既可以单独游玩，也可以选择和其他人在线组队游玩。探索普拉斯拉夫的街道，搜刮食物和物资，乞讨，偷窃，不惜一切代价，想尽任何办法来熬过即将到来的冬天。
